text:
Every shift belongs to a venue. This
tutorial shows how to add one, using

Enter the venue name, the client and the
venue type.

Set the location and the geofence radius.
Staff must be inside this area to clock in
Set the default break in minutes.

Select Create venue. The drawer stays open
so you can add pay rates.

Add an hourly rate for a role at this
venue, then select Save changes.
The new venue appears in the list.
